d: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh has criticised Prime Minister Narendra Modi over his remarks at the FICCI event, accusing him of repeating the Congress's 2024 Lok Sabha election manifesto, 'Nyay Patra'. Ramesh said Modi blamed the industry for not increasing employment, investment and salaries despite the government's measures. He also recalled how the Congress faced accusations of being 'Urban Naxals' when it raised similar concerns during the elections. Watch
